elements_selected.content: Write unit tests for the P0 Merkle infrastructure covering TEST-038 (Merkle construction), TEST-039 (SPL dual hashing), TEST-040 (two-tier cache invalidation), TEST-041 (SPL theory cache invalidation). For TEST-038: test vault root determinism (scan in different orders → same root), test normalisation (two files with identical text but different whitespace → same Merkle root), test that wikilink changes alter Merkle hash. For TEST-039: test content_hash and ast_hash computed and non-zero, test reformatting changes content_hash but not ast_hash (compare two logically identical SPL blocks), test parse error → sentinel ast_hash + diagnostic. For TEST-040: use tempfile vaults, test Tier 1 hit (mtime unchanged → no hashing call), test Tier 2 hit (touch file, same content → no downstream reprocess), test Tier 2 miss (edit content → full reprocess). For TEST-041: test prose edit → theory cache valid (no rebuild), test SPL reformat → theory cache valid, test SPL add fact → theory cache invalid. Tests in tests/ or src/ inline as #[cfg(test)].
